provenance_classification.method: The upstream Roboflow export applies "Resize to 640x640 (Fit (white edges))" to every image. All 70 records measuring exactly 640x640 were classified public_dataset; the remaining 35 carry native camera dimensions (4624x3468, 960x1280, 4000x3000) and were classified directly_collected. The two sets fall in contiguous ingestion-order blocks, which corroborates the split independently of pixel size.
provenance_classification.limitation: Pixel dimensions identify images that passed through a Roboflow export, not their ultimate origin. If any author-collected photograph was routed through the same workspace it would be classified public_dataset here. That direction is the conservative error: it declines to assert patient consent for a record rather than assuming it.
